name: Four-Point Pusher Score
description: Rapid screening grade of pushing behaviour on four levels (0–3).
license_note: Published screening score (Lagerqvist & Skargren 2006). Confirm redistribution permission before clinical deployment.
reference: Lagerqvist J, Skargren E. Pusher syndrome: reliability, validity and sensitivity to change of a classification instrument. Adv Physiother 2006;8:154–160.
